newsitem.title: USA: Latest Guyanor drilling finds lower grade.
newsitem.headline: Latest Guyanor drilling finds lower grade.

text.p: Golden Star Resources Ltd said mineralization of lower grade was found by the second phase of core drilling at the Dorlin gold property in French Guiana.
Its statement went on to say "we currently plan to report a drill indicated gold resource at Dorlin by the end of 1997."
The Dorlin property comprises 150 square kilometers in six type "B" permits located in southwestern French Guiana.
Cambior Inc is funding the exploration under an agreement allowing it it to earn a 50 percnet interest in the project.
Under a separate agreement with Cambior, Cambiex Exploration Inc has a right to earn 30 percent of Cambior's interest in the Dorlin project.
The drilling is being conducted by Guyanor Ressources SA, which is 70 percent owned by Golden Star.

The company said the second phase included 15 holes, adding significant gold mineralization was intercepted in 13, exhibiting an average intercept length of about 10 meters and a weighted average grade of about 1.5 grams per metric tonne of ore. To date, a total of 65 holes have been drilled.

Golden Star said drilling to date on the East and West Nivre zones suggests the existence of two parallel shear corridors with average widths of 150 to 300 meters, trending north-northwest, within which several "en echelon" lens-shaped bodies of mineralization have been identified. Gold mineralization within the lenses tends to be associated with sulfides, principally pyrite, locally associated with galena and chalcopyrite, with strong hydrothermal alteration.
Based upon the results from core drilling and trenching, Golden Star said, Guyanor has initiated a new core drilling campaign.

It is intended to extend the strike extension of the East and West Nivre zones to the northwest and southeast, including filling the gap between the West Nivre and South Nivre zones as well as potential link between the East Nivre zone and the Johny Wait zone, where Guyanor has discovered mineralized outcrop to the southeast of the East Nivre zone.

Jean Francois-Sauvage, Managing Director of Guyanor, commented, "Our recent core drilling campaign has done much to improve our knowledge of the nature and geometry of the mineralized bodies at Montagne Nivre.

"Though the mineralization is of lower grade, ... confirmation of our existing geologic model through further drilling should allow us to begin to evaluate a mineral resource. Our recent work on the near surface potential on Montagne Nivre has illustrated that we should be able to quantify a gold resource in the top 8 meters alone.

"The next phase of core drilling and our planned deep augering should allow us toquantify resources at MontagnuNivre and we currently plan to report a drill indicated gold resource at Dorlin by the end of 1997."
